scene: The talisman reveals transit schedules for ports, markets, and neon arcades beyond.
picture: Flat side view along a rooftop transit terrace. On the left, a gilded junk with shimmering solar sails rests by a ramp. Beside it, the young Chinese woman in a red bomber jacket and white roller skates stands holding the charm. Overhead, a dragon-headed maglev train hovers. On the right, a pink bullet train waits.
shown: a gilded solar-sail junk moored at a wooden gangway on the left
a maglev dragon train humming over a glowing track up high
a sleek pink bullet train with open sliding doors on the right
